tools.name: lookup_dns
tools.description: Resolve DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, PTR, SRV). Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402 or credits).

tools.name: lookup_whois
tools.description: Domain registration data (registrar, created/expires, status, nameservers) via RDAP. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402 or credits).

tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: IP network owner, range, country and reverse DNS. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402 or credits).

tools.name: lookup_domain_report
tools.description: One-call domain report: registration, DNS, email provider, SPF/DMARC, hosting. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402 or credits).
